title: Bit Of Create +
description: The ultimate 1.20.1 Forge Create modpack packed with the best add-ons, weapons, and trains, fully optimized with the Potato PC Booster system for massive FPS!
body:
Welcome to Bit Of Create + ! This is the ultimate 1.20.1 Forge modpack designed for everyone who loves engineering, trains, big weapons, and automation.

The best part? This modpack is fully powered by our custom "Potato PC Booster" optimization system! You can build massive factories and automated train stations without losing your FPS.

What you can expect in this modpack:
- Create Mod & The Best Add-ons: Piston systems, mechanical automation, and advanced engineering.
- Parní vlaky (Steam 'n' Rails): Build massive fully functional railway networks and stations.
- Moderní zbraně (TaCZ): Fully animated weapons and precise manufacturing systems.
- Potato PC Booster Inside: Pre-installed Embeddium, ModernFix, and FerriteCore to ensure maximum performance and 0% lag even on low-end PCs!

Turn on your engines, start your factories, and enjoy 100+ FPS in the ultimate engineering experience!
